panels.title: Радар бортов SR-01: скорость смещения по секторам (жёлтый 5, красный 15 мм/сут)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:sr-01" and r._field == "value_w1_velocity_properties_value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "W1"})

from(bucket: "default")

import "strings"
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^kz[.]bozshakol:p-/ and r._field =~ /^value_(nearest_truck_m)_properties_value$/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({twin: strings.toUpper(v: strings.split(v: r.thingId, t: ":")[1]), _value: r._value, _field: strings.trimSuffix(v: strings.trimPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "value_"), suffix: "_properties_value")}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["twin"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
